title: "1^st^ Day of 1^st^ Spring of 2^nd^ Age"
mainfont: Caveat
---

The Excised Realm, so called due to its multi part removal from the larger Eminent Realm.
Waging a war against a evasive nomadic realm the mother realm spent a fortune on what was seen as an easy campaign.
This allowed neighbouring realms to attack and claim land.
These land grabs created a small corridor between the main Eminent Realm and its southern coastal lands.

With a golden opportunity in hand the southern lands excised itself like octopus tentacle with a scalpel.
What may have died instead rose to life by the rule of The Ghoul Knight.


The Excised Realm, a small realm that cut itself away from the larger Eminent Realm.
From my current understanding the mother realm waged war against some nomadic realm.
Though the Eminent Realm won the war they lost their southern coastal lands to a ruler called The Ghoul Knight.
Yes, all knights around these parts are called The Something Knight.
They are very particular that you call them by their whole title if you're not a knight yourself.
Anyway.
Of course the Eminent Realm wants these lands back but they are weakened and surrounded by other realms who would jump at the chance to take some land from them.
In fact the border between mother and daughter is incredibly small now due to land grabs before and after the excision.

So why am I here?
I'm a biologist and have come to The Deep Country to see and document various forms of life.
I was with a whole team but they have sadly passed away due to violent locals, inclement weather, and mythic entities.
Maybe I'll recount some of my tales with them at a later point.
What's important is that one of them was a sociologist and one an architect.
We were like three amino acids in a codon.
They infected me with their passion for their fields.
Therefore, I'll include information about the fauna, flora, people, buildings, and myths of this land.

To that end I've joined a company of straight out of being anointed.
Though very green they are more trusting and lenient towards me than an older knight would be.
Who thought a nerdy biologist would become a knight's squire?
I am a fit person but these knights sure do work us to the bone.
Could be worse from the stories they tell when they were squires.

Below is the poem I overheard one of the seer's recite during the appointing.
The last three lines is the oath of knights.

<center>

**Seer**

Before you stands a human, yes,<br> But also more and also less.<br> They'll anoint you as their one true knight,<br> Wielding significant might.

Though their eyes are faded,<br> you'll boldly go forth with arms abladed.<br> For you know their vision is clear,<br> And so they'll be your wisened seer.

Now step fourth and take the oath,<br> Seer and knight will say it both.<br> The seer recites it all in guide,<br> What you repeat with whole body and mind.

Seek the myths<br> Honour the seers<br> Protect the realm

</center>

My knight is The Violet Knight.
A man of few words, dressed in an armoured beekeeper's suit.
Its creepy enough that knights always cover their face but a circle made of wicker is especially haunting.
